question.text: When a trader receives a daily Mark-to-Market (MTM) settlement amount on a futures position, the journal entry is:

answer.text: Debit: Bank or Deposit for MTM Margin Account; Credit: Mark-to-Market Margin Account
Debit: Cash Account; Credit: Capital Account
Debit: Initial Margin Account; Credit: Bank Account
No entry is required until the position is closed

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series VIII workbook (page 187), the daily MTM receipt entry debits "Bank or Deposit for MTM Margin Account" and credits the "Mark-to-Market Margin Account." Profit and Loss recognition is reserved for final settlement or squaring off of the position, as discussed on page 189. The Trap: Crediting "Profit on Futures Trading" on a daily MTM receipt conflates the daily cash settlement with final P&L recognition, which the workbook separates. Note: Source: NISM Series VIII workbook, pages 187 and 189.
